capabilities: Paste Google Maps links to create map stops with saved coordinates
Organize the itinerary by date headings, one heading per day
Follow the trip on a map that flies to the stop under the cursor
Fetch Google place details, photos and routed legs with an API key
Export the trip as KML for Google My Maps
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Google's Places and Routes APIs require billing enabled even on the free tier; the README recommends a budget alert. Map tiles and photos need network access, and saved photo references are not offline images. Complete format documentation lives in FORMAT.md. Available in English and Traditional Chinese.
motivation: The author wanted a trip plan that stays as a plain Markdown note in the vault, with the map as a view of that note, so friends and AI assistants can edit the same file.
problem: Trip planning tools split into plain documents with no map and map apps that lock plans into a hosted account, so co-editing a plan with a person or an AI assistant is awkward.
